The browser tab still shows the default Angular logo. Give the app its own tab icon (a favicon) so it looks like Plant Pals.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A new icon file is added to the `public` folder, for example `favicon.svg`, showing a plant or a water drop
- [ ] `src/index.html` points to the new icon instead of `favicon.ico`
- [ ] The browser tab shows the new icon, not the Angular logo
- [ ] The app still builds

## Hint

An SVG icon is just text, so you can write it right in the GitHub editor. Ask Copilot Chat to draft a simple one, then check what it looks like before you commit it.
